text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and even making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being explicitly programmed. By analyzing large amounts of information, they improve their performance over time. Deep learning, a more advanced technique, uses layers of artificial neural networks to recognize complex patterns, like distinguishing a cat from a dog in a photo. Today, AI is everywhere. It powers voice assistants, recommends movies on streaming platforms, helps doctors diagnose diseases, and enables self-driving cars.
